meta.title.en: Open BitLocker and Linux Drives on macOS — Lukotta
meta.title.sl: Odprite diske BitLocker in Linux v macOS — Lukotta

meta.description.en: Open BitLocker, NTFS, LUKS and Linux drives on your Mac. Type the password and the drive appears in Finder, readable and writable. Free and open source.
meta.description.sl: Odprite diske BitLocker, NTFS, LUKS in Linux na Macu. Vpišite geslo in disk se pojavi v Finderju, za branje in pisanje. Prosto programje, brezplačno.

meta.ogTitle.en: Lukotta — BitLocker, Linux and VM disks on macOS
meta.ogTitle.sl: Lukotta — diski BitLocker, Linux in navideznih naprav v macOS

meta.ogDescription.en: Plug in a drive or open a disk image, type the password, and it appears in Finder, readable and writable, like any other disk.
meta.ogDescription.sl: Priključite disk ali odprite sliko diska, vpišite geslo, in pojavi se v Finderju, za branje in pisanje, kot vsak drug disk.

meta.imageAlt.en: The Lukotta application icon: a rounded slate square with a letter L cut out of it.
meta.imageAlt.sl: Ikona programa Lukotta: zaobljen skrilavo siv kvadrat z izrezano črko L.

dialog.mobileBody.en: It needs macOS 15 Sequoia or later on an Apple Silicon Mac, and will not run on a phone or tablet.
dialog.mobileBody.sl: Potrebuje macOS 15 Sequoia ali novejši na Macu z Apple Siliconom in ne bo deloval na telefonu ali tablici.

dialog.desktopBody.en: It needs macOS 15 Sequoia or later on an Apple Silicon Mac, and will not run on {system}.
dialog.desktopBody.sl: Potrebuje macOS 15 Sequoia ali novejši na Macu z Apple Siliconom in ne bo deloval v sistemu {system}.

dialog.sendHint.en: Send this page to your Mac and download it there; AirDrop is in the list that opens. You can still download the file here, but nothing on this device will open it.
dialog.sendHint.sl: Pošljite to stran na svoj Mac — AirDrop je na seznamu, ki se odpre — in jo prenesite tam. Datoteko lahko prenesete tudi tukaj, a je na tej napravi ne bo nič odprlo.

dialog.copyHint.en: Copy the link and open it on your Mac to download there. You can still download the file here, but nothing on this device will open it.
dialog.copyHint.sl: Kopirajte povezavo in jo odprite na Macu, da prenesete tam. Datoteko lahko prenesete tudi tukaj, a je na tej napravi ne bo nič odprlo.

hero.title.en: Open BitLocker, Linux and virtual machine disks on macOS.
hero.title.sl: Odprite diske BitLocker, Linux in navideznih naprav v macOS.

hero.subtitle.en: Plug in a drive or open a disk image and type the password, and it appears in Finder. Readable and writable, like any other disk.
hero.subtitle.sl: Priključite disk ali odprite sliko diska in vpišite geslo — pojavi se v Finderju. Za branje in pisanje, kot vsak drug disk.

hero.meta.en: Version {version} · Apple Silicon · macOS 15 Sequoia or later
hero.meta.sl: Različica {version} · Apple Silicon · macOS 15 Sequoia ali novejši

hero.screenshotAlt.en: The Lukotta window on macOS, listing the drives connected to the Mac and what each one holds.
hero.screenshotAlt.sl: Okno programa Lukotta v macOS z diski, priključenimi na Mac, in tem, kaj vsebuje vsak od njih.

how.lead.en: macOS cannot read BitLocker or Linux filesystems. Linux can. Lukotta starts a small Linux virtual machine, unlocks the drive inside it, and hands the drive back to Finder.
how.lead.sl: macOS ne zna brati BitLockerja ne datotečnih sistemov Linux. Linux zna. Lukotta zažene majhno navidezno napravo z Linuxom, v njej odklene disk in ga izroči Finderju.

how.2.body.en: A volume password, a LUKS passphrase, or a 48-digit BitLocker recovery key.
how.2.body.sl: Geslo nosilca, geslo LUKS ali 48-mestni obnovitveni ključ BitLocker.

how.3.body.en: The volume appears under Locations, and reads, writes and ejects like any other drive.
how.3.body.sl: Nosilec se pojavi pod Lokacije ter se bere, zapisuje in izvrže kot vsak drug disk.

features.lead.en: Lukotta opens drives and disk images that macOS refuses to read, and gives them to Finder as ordinary volumes.
features.lead.sl: Lukotta odpira diske in slike diskov, ki jih macOS noče brati, in jih izroči Finderju kot običajne nosilce.

features.body.en: It takes physical drives and image files alike. A BitLocker volume opens with its password or with a 48-digit recovery key, and BitLocker and NTFS volumes are both read and written, so files can be copied onto a drive as well as off it.
features.body.sl: Enako sprejme fizične diske in datoteke slik. Nosilec BitLocker se odpre s svojim geslom ali z 48-mestnim obnovitvenim ključem, nosilci BitLocker in NTFS pa se berejo in zapisujejo, tako da je datoteke mogoče kopirati na disk prav tako kot z njega.

features.body2.en: Any drive or image can be opened read-only instead, and Lukotta can reopen whatever was open the last time you were logged in.
features.body2.sl: Vsak disk ali sliko je mogoče odpreti tudi samo za branje, Lukotta pa zna znova odpreti to, kar je bilo odprto ob zadnji prijavi.

formats.bitlocker.note.en: Unlocked with the volume password or a 48-digit recovery key
formats.bitlocker.note.sl: Odklene se z geslom nosilca ali 48-mestnim obnovitvenim ključem

formats.lvm.note.en: Several volumes on one drive unlock together
formats.lvm.note.sl: Več nosilcev na istem disku se odklene skupaj

formats.ntfs.note.en: Including a volume Windows left dirty or hibernated
formats.ntfs.note.sl: Tudi nosilec, ki ga je Windows pustil v mirovanju ali slabo zaprl

formats.vmdkStream.note.en: What an OVA carries. Written in one pass, so it cannot be changed in place
formats.vmdkStream.note.sl: Kar vsebuje OVA. Zapiše se v enem prehodu, zato ga ni mogoče spreminjati na mestu

formats.vhdx.note.sl: Hyper-V. Odpre se samo za branje

formats.specs.en: Every format in full detail, including how each one is read and written
formats.specs.sl: Vsak zapis podrobno, in kako se kateri bere in zapisuje

formats.experimental.en: Support for these formats is experimental. Writing to them has not been extensively tested.
formats.experimental.sl: Podpora tem zapisom je preizkusna. Pisanje vanje ni bilo obsežno preizkušeno.

formats.not.1.en: FileVault and encrypted disk images, which macOS opens itself
formats.not.1.sl: FileVault in šifrirane slike diskov, ki jih macOS odpre sam

formats.not.2.en: Drives sealed to a TPM rather than a password, including Ubuntu's newer hardware-backed encryption
formats.not.2.sl: Diski, vezani na čip TPM namesto na geslo, vključno z novejšim strojnim šifriranjem v Ubuntuju

formats.not.3.en: LUKS volumes whose header is stored away from the drive
formats.not.3.sl: Nosilci LUKS, katerih glava je shranjena ločeno od diska

formats.not.5.en: An image that names another file: a VMware snapshot chain, a differencing VHD, or a qcow2 with a backing file
formats.not.5.sl: Slika, ki se sklicuje na drugo datoteko: veriga posnetkov VMware, diferencialni VHD ali qcow2 z osnovno datoteko

name.body.en: Lúkotta is Finnish for “without a lock”, from {lukko}, a lock, with the ending {tta} marking the absence of something. The stress falls on the first syllable, as it always does in Finnish.
name.body.sl: Lúkotta v finščini pomeni »brez ključavnice«, iz {lukko}, kar je ključavnica, s končnico {tta}, ki označuje odsotnost česa. Naglas pade na prvi zlog, kot vedno v finščini.

faq.1.a.en: Nothing. It is free to download and free to use. There is no paid version, no subscription, no trial that runs out and no account to make.
faq.1.a.sl: Nič. Prenos je brezplačen in uporaba tudi. Ni plačljive različice, ni naročnine, ni preizkusnega obdobja, ki poteče, in ni računa, ki bi ga bilo treba ustvariti.

faq.1.a2.en: It is also free software, under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later. The source is public: you can read it, build it yourself, change it, and pass on what you change.
faq.1.a2.sl: Je tudi prosto programje pod licenco GNU General Public License, različica 3 ali novejša. Izvorna koda je javna: lahko jo berete, sami zgradite, spremenite in posredujete naprej, kar ste spremenili.

faq.2.a.en: Yes, and write to them. Type the volume password or paste a 48-digit recovery key, and the drive opens in Finder.
faq.2.a.sl: Da, in piše nanje. Vpišite geslo nosilca ali prilepite 48-mestni obnovitveni ključ in disk se odpre v Finderju.

faq.3.q.en: Can Lukotta write to NTFS drives?
faq.3.q.sl: Ali Lukotta piše na diske NTFS?

faq.3.a.en: Yes. Files copy onto an NTFS drive as well as off it.
faq.3.a.sl: Da. Datoteke se na disk NTFS kopirajo prav tako kot z njega.

faq.4.a.en: Yes. ext2, ext3, ext4, btrfs and XFS open, plain or inside LUKS encryption. A drive laid out with LVM opens all its volumes together.
faq.4.a.sl: Da. ext2, ext3, ext4, btrfs in XFS se odprejo, sami ali znotraj šifriranja LUKS. Disk, urejen z LVM, odpre vse svoje nosilce skupaj.

faq.5.q.en: Can Lukotta open a virtual machine's disk?
faq.5.q.sl: Ali Lukotta odpre disk navidezne naprave?

faq.5.a.en: Yes, without starting the machine. Open a qcow2, VMDK, VDI, VHD or VHDX image and copy files out of it, or into it.
faq.5.a.sl: Da, brez zagona naprave. Odprite sliko qcow2, VMDK, VDI, VHD ali VHDX in kopirajte datoteke iz nje ali vanjo.

faq.6.q.en: Does Lukotta run on an Intel Mac?
faq.6.q.sl: Ali Lukotta deluje na Macu s procesorjem Intel?

faq.6.a.en: No. It needs the virtualisation Apple Silicon provides.
faq.6.a.sl: Ne. Potrebuje virtualizacijo, ki jo ponuja Apple Silicon.
